D: A naive Texan hustler and a sickly con man scrape by together in New York.

S: ham and cheese out of the little glass doors
Leg ham and Swiss on white with mustard butter, crusts off, cut into quarters, wrapped in wax paper.
the cheap diner breakfasts Joe Buck counts his coins for

Hot cinnamon sugar doughnut holes, fried to order, with a little pot of coffee custard for dunking. Mix 250g self-raising flour, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg, 150ml milk and 30g melted butter into a soft dough. Roll into 24 small balls. Fry at 170C for 3 minutes until golden and cooked through, then roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 300ml custard with 2 tsp instant coffee dissolved in 1 tbsp hot water and serve warm for dipping.

Brown sliced franks in a pot, soften onion, add tinned beans, smoked paprika, a spoon of molasses and mustard, simmer 20 minutes. Toast on the side.

W: Boil 2 whole oranges for 1 hour, blitz, mix with 6 eggs, 250g sugar, 250g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder, bake at 180C for 1 hour.
K: Ratso's dream of sunshine in Florida

Coconut water, pineapple and fresh lime shaken with a little coconut cream, poured over ice with a pineapple wedge and white rum on the side. Shake 400ml coconut water, 300ml pineapple juice, 60ml lime juice and 60ml coconut cream with ice for 15 seconds until frothy. Strain into 4 ice-filled tall glasses. Add 30ml white rum to each glass for a boozy version. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a lime wheel.

s.note: Crustless ham and Swiss quarters with mustard butter, wrapped in wax paper.
s.how: Mash 40g soft butter with 1 tsp Dijon mustard and spread over 8 slices white bread. Fill with 200g leg ham and 4 slices Swiss cheese. Cut off the crusts, cut into quarters and wrap in wax paper, like the automat windows.

s.note: Hot cinnamon sugar doughnut holes, fried to order, with a little pot of coffee custard for dunking.

Fry at 170C for 3 minutes until golden and cooked through, then roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 300ml custard with 2 tsp instant coffee dissolved in 1 tbsp hot water and serve warm for dipping.

m.note: Crunchy coconut prawns with sweet chilli and lime.
m.how: Butterfly 600g green prawns, leaving the tails on. Dust in 50g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 80g panko mixed with 80g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Serve with 150ml sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

w.note: Whole boiled orange and almond cake, moist and fragrant.
w.how: Boil 2 whole oranges for 1 hour until soft, cool and blitz smooth, skin and all. Beat 6 eggs with 250g caster sugar, then mix in the oranges, 250g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder. Pour into a lined 22cm tin and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Cool in the tin.
